trans-unit.source: Odkazy na validované informační zdroje – např. klinické doporučené postupy nebo informační materiály.
trans-unit.target:
Links or references to disease-specific information resources, clinical practice guidelines, or care pathways relevant to the patient’s condition. Provides treating team with decision support and references to best practice care protocols.

This data element is Not Mandatory in the Electronic Health Record but is to be included in the Patient Summary of the EHDS.

The recommended data standard is EHDSCondition.externalResource

trans-unit.target:
Critical clinical alerts concerning the patient that require attention (e.g., allergies, implantable devices, high-risk conditions, medication contraindications).
Helps to highlight patient safety and alert the treating team at the point of care.

The recommended data standard is Logical Model: Alert Model

trans-unit.source: Zaznamenaná přání pacienta pro budoucí rozhodování o péči. Dataset označuje položku jako volitelnou v EHR a požadovanou pro EHDS Patient Summary; konkrétní reprezentace dokumentu je úkolem implementačního profilu.
trans-unit.target:
Documented patient wishes regarding future healthcare decisions and end-of-life care preferences (Do not resuscitate orders, etc.). Informs treating team of patient’s advanced and legal directives.

This data element is Not Mandatory in the Electronic Health Record but is to be included in the Patient Summary of the EHDS.

The recommended data standard is Logical Model: Advance directive model
•	https://www.xt-ehr.eu/fhir/models/0.2.1/StructureDefinition-EHDSAdvanceDirective.html#root
